meta.name: Free VST Plugins
meta.description: Curated collection of high-quality free VST plugins for macOS, Windows, and Linux
meta.author: gr8monk3ys

synths.name: Surge XT
synths.description: Open-source hybrid synth - wavetable, FM, subtractive. 2800+ presets

synths.name: Dexed
synths.description: Yamaha DX7 FM synth clone - loads thousands of classic patches

synths.name: OB-Xd
synths.description: Oberheim OB-X emulation - fat analog polysynth

synths.name: Helm
synths.description: Polyphonic synth with deep modulation routing

synths.name: TAL-NoiseMaker
synths.description: Classic VA synth - 256 presets, low CPU usage

synths.name: Tyrell N6
synths.description: u-he analog synth - 580+ presets, native binaries

synths.name: Zebralette
synths.description: u-he wavetable oscillator - deep sound design capabilities

synths.name: OB-Xf
synths.description: Oberheim OB-X/OB-Xa emulation - successor to OB-Xd from the Surge Synth Team
synths.note: Windows download is a portable zip (VST3 + CLAP bundles, no installer)

synths.name: Vaporizer2
synths.description: Hybrid wavetable/additive synth - 4 oscillators, sampler, analog-style filters, 1,000+ presets

synths.name: Podolski
synths.description: u-he's free one-oscillator VA synth - arpeggiator/sequencer, chorus and delay

synths.name: Triple Cheese
synths.description: u-he's free comb-filter synth - plucks, bells and lo-fi textures from three resonators

effects.name: Valhalla Supermassive
effects.description: Lush reverbs & delays - 21 modes, studio quality
effects.note: macOS auto-download. Windows requires the form gate on valhalladsp.com/demos-downloads/

effects.name: Valhalla FreqEcho
effects.description: Frequency shifter + analog echo emulation
effects.note: macOS auto-download. Windows requires the form gate on valhalladsp.com/demos-downloads/

effects.name: OTT
effects.description: THE multiband compressor - industry standard
effects.note: macOS auto-download. Windows requires going to xferrecords.com/freeware (the direct URL serves a JSON gate response)

effects.name: Dragonfly Reverb
effects.description: 4 reverbs - Hall, Room, Plate, Early Reflections

effects.name: BYOD
effects.description: Build-Your-Own-Distortion - modular effects chain

effects.name: TDR Nova
effects.description: Dynamic EQ - parallel bands, pro mixing tool

effects.name: Airwindows Consolidated
effects.description: 350+ effects in one plugin - saturation, tape, console, everything

effects.name: TAL-Vocoder
effects.description: Classic 80s vocoder sound - 11 bands

effects.name: CHOW Tape Model
effects.description: Physical model of a reel-to-reel tape machine - saturation, hysteresis, wow & flutter, loss

effects.name: ChowMatrix
effects.description: Delay-tree effect - branching, modulated analog-style delay lines

effects.name: ChowPhaser
effects.description: Phaser modelled on the Schulte Compact Phasing 'A' - light-dependent-resistor LFO

effects.name: TAL-Chorus-LX
effects.description: Juno-60 chorus emulation - modes I, II and I+II

effects.name: TAL-Reverb-4
effects.description: Plate reverb with a vintage 80s character - modulation, pre-delay, stereo width

effects.name: Protoverb
effects.description: u-he's free experimental reverb - a modelled corridor, from small rooms to noisy lo-fi spaces

effects.name: PaulXStretch
effects.description: Extreme time-stretching (Paulstretch) for drones, pads and ambient washes

effects.name: Neural Amp Modeler
effects.description: Neural amp/pedal capture player (.nam files) with built-in cab IR loader and noise gate
effects.note: Pinned to v0.7.13, the last GitHub release with binaries (v0.7.14/v0.7.15 have none, and the release also carries debug-symbol zips that confuse asset matching), so it has no update_strategy. Reads classic WaveNet/LSTM captures but not the newer A2 ones; use Gateway (NAM) for those.

effects.name: Gateway (NAM)
effects.description: The renamed Neural Amp Modeler plugin (1.x) - plays classic and A2 .nam captures plus cab IRs
effects.note: Official binaries are hosted on Google Drive (linked from neuralampmodeler.com/users), not GitHub releases. Windows installer is Inno Setup 6.7.

effects.name: TONE3000
effects.description: TONE3000's NAM/IR player with a multi-block rig; loads local .nam and IR files
effects.note: Plugin is free with no account; loading tones from the TONE3000 library needs a free account (local .nam/IR files work without one). Needs the WebView2 runtime on Windows.

effects.name: Youlean Loudness Meter 2
effects.description: LUFS/true-peak loudness meter with history graph - free edition
effects.note: Windows zip includes a manual-install folder with a single-file VST3.

effects.name: Voxengo SPAN
effects.description: Real-time FFT spectrum analyzer with correlation and level meters

effects.name: Graillon 3 Free
effects.description: Pitch correction, pitch and formant shifting - free edition of Auburn Sounds Graillon
effects.note: One zip for all platforms. The free edition lacks pitch-tracking modulation, keyboard tuning and the vocal doubler.

effects.name: TDR Kotelnikov
effects.description: Transparent mastering/bus compressor with separate peak and RMS release
effects.note: Windows build is the portable (no installer) zip; copy VST3/x64/TDR Kotelnikov.vst3 into your VST3 folder.

effects.name: TDR Molotok
effects.description: Characterful vintage-style compressor (free sibling of TDR Molot GE)
effects.note: Windows build is the portable (no installer) zip.

effects.name: TAL-Dub-X
effects.description: Analog-modelled dub/tape-style delay with filter, saturation and modulation

instruments.name: Sitala
instruments.description: Drum sampler - 16 pads, drag & drop simplicity

instruments.name: sfizz
instruments.description: SFZ sample player - loads free SFZ libraries (Salamander piano, VSCO 2 orchestra, ...)

instruments.name: RipplerX
instruments.description: Physically modelled percussion - mallets, marimba, bells, membranes and plucked strings

instruments.name: SocaLabs Organ
instruments.description: Tonewheel organ based on setBfree - drawbars, percussion, vibrato/chorus, rotary speaker
instruments.note: Release asset names carry no version, so there is no update_strategy; bump the tag in the URLs by hand

instruments.name: SocaLabs Piano
instruments.description: Physically modelled piano - no samples, tiny download
instruments.note: Release asset names carry no version, so there is no update_strategy; bump the tag in the URLs by hand

bundles.name: MeldaProduction MFreeFXBundle
bundles.description: 37 free effects - EQ, compressor, reverb, analyzer, more
bundles.note: Requires MPluginManager to install individual plugins

bundles.name: Cardinal
bundles.description: VCV Rack-based modular synth as a plugin - 1,000+ built-in modules, synth/FX/main variants

samples.name: Virtual Playing Orchestra 3 (wave files)
samples.description: Full free orchestra in SFZ - string sections and solos, brass, woodwinds, choir, harp, celesta, mallets, timpani. The samples; pair with a VPO scripts package
samples.license: Mixed: Sonatina (CC Sampling Plus 1.0), Mattias Westlund (CC BY-SA 3.0), No Budget Orchestra (CC BY-SA 4.0), VSCO 2 CE and stamperadam (CC0), University of Iowa (unrestricted). Music made with it needs no attribution; redistributing the samples needs credit.
samples.note: 616 MB. archive.org mirror linked from virtualplaying.com (its other two mirrors are OneDrive/Google Drive share pages). Unzip into the same folder as a scripts package.

samples.name: Virtual Playing Orchestra 3 (standard scripts)
samples.description: The .sfz instrument files for VPO 3 - sustain, staccato, pizzicato, keyswitch and mod-wheel patches
samples.license: Mixed: Sonatina (CC Sampling Plus 1.0), Mattias Westlund (CC BY-SA 3.0), No Budget Orchestra (CC BY-SA 4.0), VSCO 2 CE and stamperadam (CC0), University of Iowa (unrestricted). Music made with it needs no attribution; redistributing the samples needs credit.
samples.note: Works with wave files 3.1 and 3.2. Extract into the same folder as the wave files. With sfizz 1.2.3, the scripts' delay_random lines can leave notes hanging; comment them out if you render or play through sfizz.

samples.name: Virtual Playing Orchestra 3 (performance scripts)
samples.description: VPO 3 'PERF' patches - mod-wheel dynamics and legato-style transitions for more expressive lines
samples.license: Mixed: Sonatina (CC Sampling Plus 1.0), Mattias Westlund (CC BY-SA 3.0), No Budget Orchestra (CC BY-SA 4.0), VSCO 2 CE and stamperadam (CC0), University of Iowa (unrestricted). Music made with it needs no attribution; redistributing the samples needs credit.
samples.note: Works with wave files 3.1 and 3.2. Extract into the same folder as the wave files. With sfizz 1.2.3, the scripts' delay_random lines can leave notes hanging; comment them out if you render or play through sfizz.

samples.name: Sonatina Symphonic Orchestra
samples.description: Peter Eastman's continued SSO - sections and solo strings, brass, woodwinds with legato, chorus, harpsichord, organ, celeste, harp, tuned percussion
samples.note: 1.4 GB GitHub tag archive (the release has no assets); its hash was identical across two downloads. Tested with sfizz.

samples.name: Karoryfer x bigcat Cello
samples.description: Solo cello - bowed (velocity or mod-wheel dynamics, sustain/staccato/marcato) and plucked

samples.name: Karoryfer Bear Sax
samples.description: 1926 Conn baritone saxophone - sustain, marcato, staccato, subtone, growl; solo and duo

samples.name: Karoryfer Weresax
samples.description: Alto saxophone with deep vibrato controls, plus 'saxcordion' and a sax-based synth

samples.name: Karoryfer War Tuba
samples.description: Tuba - sustain, staccato, staccatissimo; solo, duo and trio, legato and poly

samples.name: MTG Solo Saxophones
samples.description: Soprano, alto, tenor and baritone sax built from the MTG freesound packs - looped, mod-wheel vibrato, legato mode
samples.note: No releases; pinned to a commit archive. Bump the commit in the URL by hand.

samples.name: Ixox Flute
samples.description: Two-flute patch from Xavier Hosxe's Ixox Flute VSTi - vibrato, legato, staccato
samples.note: No releases; pinned to a commit archive. Bump the commit in the URL by hand.

samples.name: FreePats Button Accordion HN
samples.description: Diatonic button accordion, tuned - the only clean free SFZ accordion

samples.name: FreePats Upright Piano KW
samples.description: Upright piano with a warm, slightly worn tone - good for chamber pop

samples.name: Plogue sforzatron
samples.description: Mellotron M400S tapes (Taijiguy samples) - strings, cello, flute, choir, brass, woodwinds
samples.license: Freeware: Taijiguy's samples, used with permission; free for music, not for resale
samples.note: Built for Plogue sforzando, which defines $sample_dir. In sfizz, load a mapping through a wrapper that does '#define $sample_dir ../Samples' first.

manual_download.name: DC1A
manual_download.description: Klanghelm character compressor - simple but powerful
manual_download.reason: Direct download URL serves an HTML download-gate page; Klanghelm requires navigating their site

manual_download.name: Vital
manual_download.description: Best free wavetable synth - rivals Serum ($189 value)

manual_download.name: Spitfire LABS
manual_download.description: High-quality sampled instruments - piano, strings, pads
manual_download.reason: Requires Spitfire Audio app and account

manual_download.name: Native Instruments Komplete Start
manual_download.description: Free bundle with synths, samples, and effects

manual_download.name: AmpliTube 5 CS
manual_download.description: Free guitar amp sim with 42 gear models
manual_download.reason: Requires IK Product Manager and account

manual_download.name: LSP Plugins
manual_download.reason: Available via package managers on Linux

manual_download.name: Odin 2
manual_download.description: 24-voice hybrid synth - analog, wavetable, FM, vector & chiptune oscillators
manual_download.reason: Stable 2.4.0 installers are Dropbox share links on the vendor page; GitHub only carries the NightlyDevel builds, which upstream says not to use

manual_download.name: Decent Sampler
manual_download.description: Free sample player for the large Decent Sampler / Pianobook instrument ecosystem
manual_download.reason: Download links are sent after an email sign-up form

manual_download.name: MT Power Drum Kit 2
manual_download.description: Acoustic rock/pop drum kit with a built-in groove library
manual_download.reason: JavaScript-only download page that requires accepting a EULA; no static file URL

manual_download.name: Mel-Lofi
manual_download.description: Mellotron emulation built on Taijiguy's samples - strings, flutes, choirs
manual_download.reason: Distributed through a Gumroad checkout (email required, $0 price)

manual_download.name: VCSL (Versilian Community Sample Library)
manual_download.description: CC0 harpsichords, recorders, harps, vibraphone, tubular bells, pipe organ, tenor sax and lots of percussion, with SFZ mappings
manual_download.reason: No release archive: the SFZ files live on the repo's `sfz` branch (about 6 GB with samples). Clone it, ideally sparse: git clone --filter=blob:none --branch sfz https://github.com/sgossner/VCSL.git

manual_download.name: BBC Symphony Orchestra Discover
manual_download.description: Spitfire's free 33-instrument orchestra in its own player
manual_download.reason: Requires a Spitfire Audio account and the Spitfire app

manual_download.name: Orchestral Tools SINEfactory
manual_download.description: Free SINE-player instruments - string ensembles, flutes, pianos, percussion
manual_download.reason: Requires an Orchestral Tools account and the SINE player

manual_download.name: Muse Sounds
manual_download.description: MuseScore's free orchestral libraries (Muse Strings, Brass, Woodwinds, Choir) via Muse Hub
manual_download.reason: Delivered only through the Muse Hub app (account sign-in); the sounds play inside MuseScore Studio

manual_download.name: Tuna
manual_download.description: Aurora DSP's free resizable guitar/bass tuner (down to 40 Hz)
manual_download.reason: Free licence must be claimed with an Aurora DSP account before the private download link appears

manual_download.name: T-De-Esser 2
manual_download.reason: Download goes through Techivation's cart/account flow; no direct file URL
